purpose: Verified actionable access routes for patient-facing treatment trial cards. Prefer direct study/institutional contacts over generic pages.

verified_overrides.center: NC State College of Veterinary Medicine
verified_overrides.contacts: NC State Clinical Studies Core — cvmclinicalstudies@ncsu.edu; Clinical Studies Core / Oncology: 919-513-6690
verified_overrides.verification: Current NC State clinical-trials and oncology pages explicitly direct owners to the research team/department for eligibility and enrollment. Individual trial flyers use cvmclinicalstudies@ncsu.edu.

verified_overrides.center: University of Florida College of Veterinary Medicine
verified_overrides.contacts: Enrollment requires the referring veterinarian to complete UF's Oncology Referral Form; UF Oncology Staff: 352-392-2235
verified_overrides.verification: UF's current oncology clinical-trials page states that participation requires the referring veterinarian to complete the Oncology Referral Form and lists currently enrolling oncology studies.

verified_overrides.center: Colorado State University Flint Animal Cancer Center
verified_overrides.contacts: CSU Flint Animal Cancer Center / Clinical Trials — 970-297-4195; use the current Cancer Care appointment/information request or the trial-specific consult form
verified_overrides.verification: CSU Veterinary Health System maintains a current open-trials page and Cancer Care access pathway; the Cancer Care service lists 970-297-4195 for appointments/general information and links clinical trials directly.

verified_overrides.center: Ontario Veterinary College — University of Guelph
verified_overrides.contacts: OVC Clinical Trials — ovc.clinicaltrials@uoguelph.ca; use the official study contact form where present
verified_overrides.verification: Current OVC study records expose a Clinical Trials email and/or study contact form; use the study-specific page when available.

display_policy.required_for_patient_facing_match: At least one actionable route: direct study email, phone, enrollment/contact form, or named referral center.
display_policy.generic_homepage_only: Do not present a generic institutional homepage as if it were an enrollment route.
display_policy.dead_or_missing_url: Keep a verified direct email/phone visible and do not render a dead enrollment button.
display_policy.europe: Investigator/referral-center email or phone is a valid primary enrollment route when no dedicated enrollment form exists.
